pairing_rule: Use matched baseline/candidate assigned workloads with equal verification/risk and precommitted eligible-wake, exposure/censoring and admission/defer/timeout policies. Randomize AB/BA or crossover from the same sealed starting snapshot, reset candidate-sensitive runtime state between arms, preserve external monotonic audit state, report order interaction and intention-to-treat coverage.

denominator_integrity.rule: Both arms must use identical authoritative v2/v2.1 event classification, receipt acceptance, canonical verification-stage and real_experience_claim_allowed semantics. A positive verified-looking event under a non-C_VERIFIED canonical stage or without an exact trusted verifier/C acceptance receipt contributes zero authoritative verified Experience and cannot improve any speed numerator. DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND remain operational-only and durable_progress_per_wake may count only immutable evidence-bound operational acceptance receipts. Malformed input, EventKind/EventIdentity, N/R, pressure provenance, exposure/censoring and defer/reject policies must also be common between arms.
denominator_integrity.reject: No positive speed claim may be produced by pre-C/non-C verified-credit leakage, stage-label forgery, legacy authoritative Experience leakage, minted caller-only operational events, duplicate evidence under new IDs, malformed-row censoring, N/R failure, awake/window/commit/heartbeat/poll/retry proxies or unequal routing semantics.

selection_bias_control.rule: Use intention-to-treat assigned-workload analysis and report exact trusted C/verifier acceptance receipts, canonical verification stage, authoritative verified Experience receipts separately from accepted operational evidence root/count, verified closures, defer/reject/timeout, unsupported operational claims, lineage duplicates, malformed-record outcomes, N/R safety outcomes, coverage and assignment-to-closure latency under common failure/censoring semantics.
